# `pay_invoice_approval` (Pairly Pay)

An invoice sent for approval waits for the approvers its rules pick.

* Workflow: `pay`, graph version 1.
* Started with `pay.invoice.submit`, read with `pay.invoice.read`.
* Approval types: `pay.invoice`.
* Final actions (run by the engine after a person approves): `approve_invoice`.
